question: On which parts of the body or attire may rudrākṣa be worn?
premises: The hand is named as a place of wearing.
Both ears are named as places of wearing.
The sacred thread is named as a place of wearing.
inference: Rudrākṣa may be worn on the hand, on both ears, and on the sacred thread.
